questions.prompt: When priorities conflict, how strongly do you prefer choosing the option that is most consistent with your principles?
How important is long-term impact compared with immediate convenience?
I do my best work when I can protect uninterrupted focus time.
I prefer a clear plan before starting a complex task.
Before making an important decision, how much evidence do you usually seek?
When information is incomplete, I am comfortable making a reversible first move.
I learn best by experimenting and adjusting from feedback.
I prefer structured explanations before trying something new.
For important topics, I prefer direct and explicit communication.
I prefer written context that I can review before responding.
How comfortable are you pursuing an opportunity when the outcome is uncertain?
I prefer a smaller safe experiment over a large irreversible commitment.
I reliably break large goals into smaller scheduled actions.
I can change plans without losing track of the most important outcome.
I make expectations explicit when collaborating with someone.
I need time to build trust before sharing uncertain ideas.
I often generate multiple alternatives before selecting an approach.
Constraints tend to help me find more inventive solutions.
A predictable environment helps me maintain focus.
I can do high-quality work despite frequent interruptions.
